conformance_rationale.semantic_review: Mapping a block to an IR object establishes that the renderer declared the object, not that the prose realizes it with the same meaning and force. Section 15.3 requires every surfaced finding to be dispositioned by an authorized human or a promoted detector, and Section 14.11 assigns final semantic acceptance to an external authority. This implementation holds neither, so semantic_review is never PASS here.
